I didn't edit `migrations/0007_add_customers.sql`. I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers_email.sql` instead:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

A project memory says files in `migrations/` are applied in production and must never be edited. Fixes go in a new file with the next number. Editing 0007 in place would leave the database with `emial` while the file said `email`, and the migration tooling may also reject the changed file.

`emial` appears only in 0007, so nothing else in the repo needs updating. I haven't run the migration.

If 0007 has never been applied anywhere, say so and I'll edit it in place. In that case the memory is out of date and should be changed too.
